# Binding Wire Machine (Indian Nail Machine)

> Industrial Wire Nail, Continuous Wire Drawing, and Binding Wire Machinery Manufacturer and Exporter based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Binding Wire Machine (Alternate: Indian Nail Machine)
- **Proprietor:** Yasin Ahamed Sandhi
- **Factory Address:** Aji Industrial Area, Phase-2, Shed No. 123, Rajkot, Gujarat - 360003, India
- **Coordinates:** 22.2858° N, 70.7997° E
- **Primary Contact:** +91 99788 22099 (Direct Phone & WhatsApp)
- **Email:** info@bindingwiremachine.com | bindingwiremachinery@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.bindingwiremachine.in
- **Certification:** ISO 9001:2015 Certified Manufacturing Facility

## Machinery Specifications & Production Capabilities

### 1. High-Speed Automatic Wire Nail Making Machines (IN Series)
- **IN1+ Model:** 
  - Nail Length: 0.5" to 1.0" (12mm - 25mm)
  - Speed: 550 nails/min
  - Motor: 1.5 HP (3-Phase)
  - Weight: ~600 kg
  - Price Range: ₹1,50,000 INR ($1,850 USD)
- **IN3 Model (Industry Standard):** 
  - Nail Length: 1.0" to 3.0" (25mm - 75mm)
  - Speed: 350 nails/min
  - Motor: 3.0 HP (3-Phase)
  - Weight: ~1,000 kg
  - Price Range: ₹2,20,000 INR ($2,650 USD)
- **IN4 Model:** 
  - Nail Length: 2.0" to 4.0" (50mm - 100mm)
  - Speed: 250 nails/min
  - Motor: 5.0 HP (3-Phase)
  - Weight: ~1,400 kg
  - Price Range: ₹3,10,000 INR ($3,750 USD)
- **IN6 Model (Heavy Duty):** 
  - Nail Length: 3.0" to 6.0" (75mm - 150mm)
  - Speed: 150 nails/min
  - Motor: 7.5 HP (3-Phase)
  - Weight: ~2,220 kg
  - Price Range: ₹4,50,000 INR ($5,400 USD)

### 2. Continuous Wire Drawing Machine Plant (WDM-600)
- **Inlet Wire Gauge:** 5.5 mm to 10.0 mm (Mild Steel / High Carbon)
- **Outlet Wire Gauge:** 1.2 mm to 4.0 mm
- **Blocks:** 3 to 7 Multi-Die Bull Blocks with water-cooling drums
- **Line Speed:** Up to 12 m/s with Variable Frequency Drive (VFD)
- **Price Range:** ₹6,50,000 INR ($7,800 USD)

### 3. Binding Wire Making Plant (BWM-300)
- **Finished Diameter:** 0.9 mm to 1.6 mm (20 to 16 SWG)
- **Annealing Furnace:** Pit-type electrical resistance annealing furnace (1 to 5 Ton capacity)
- **Output:** 3 to 5 Tons/Day soft annealed black construction binding wire
- **Price Range:** ₹2,80,000 INR ($3,400 USD)

## Export Logistics
- Worldwide freight forwarding via Mundra Port & Kandla Port (Gujarat, India).
- Containerized wooden crate packaging with rust-preventive marine coatings.
